title: City library opens a night reading room (sample)
description: A made-up news article for testing the app.

discover_cards.title: A reading room open at night
discover_cards.front: The invented city library now keeps one reading room open until 2 a.m.

discover_cards.title: Who comes at night
discover_cards.front: In the first month, most night visitors were students and shift workers.

discover_cards.title: Quiet hours
discover_cards.front: People told us the night is the only quiet time they have.
discover_cards.speaker: Rosa Example, librarian

discover_cards.title: What it costs
discover_cards.front: The extra hours cost the library about as much as one new staff member.

discover_cards.title: Other cities
discover_cards.front: Two other invented cities plan to try night rooms next year.

practice_cards.prompt: Until what time is the night reading room open?
Match each fact with the article.
